policy: Unmodified bounded beam6 turn planner and reward heuristic. Baseline naturally reaches chapter; the identical chapter save is branched only by library encounter ID, then candidate engine resolves both. Equal chapter HP/deck/RNG and exact battle4 opening hand/draw/energy verified. Moon/library/rest; later draw/reward paths can diverge because battles differ. Tracks only ended turns, not lethal player turns. Not human choice frequencies, difficulty, optimum, or fun.
